text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"—Here is your purchase. Thank you very 
much for your patronage!"

One day off, just a few days before 
Valentine's Day. Clutching the paper bag 
to my chest, I left the scene feeling 
warmly content.
choice_data_list:
(Bubble's definitely going to love these 
chocolates~)

text_block_list.text:
Knowing she had a sweet tooth, I casually 
stopped by the shop... and found the 
absolute perfect treat!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see their happy faces!

text_block_list.text:
Filled with excitement, Valentine's Day 
finally arrived. Right away, I spotted 
Bubble on her way to school—however,

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble-senpai! Please take this♪ —We're 
rooting for you in your race...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Whoa, thank you everyone! I'm so happy.
choice_data_list:
(Wow... she's surrounded like something 
straight out of a manga)

text_block_list.text:
Seeing the crowd gathered around, I was 
left stunned. I knew they were popular, 
but to this extent...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "U-Um, Bubble-senpai! I also, this—"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"You probably don't remember, Senpai, 
but... when I was feeling really down 
before, you gave me a drink. ...It 
honestly helped me so much."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, Senpai, I can still run! 
Thank you so much for what you did back 
then!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Thank *you* for such a wonderful 
gift! I'll savor every bite.

... I feel it would be tasteless to 
interrupt them.
choice_data_list: (Guess I'll give it to her at lunchtime.)
(Maybe I'll hand it over at lunchtime.)

text_block_list.text:
"I'll give it to her when the time is 
right. That was what I had thought, but—"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
"Please enjoy our chocolate bucket 
pudding, made with all our love! ♡"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whoa, this is amazing! ...Is it 
really handmade?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yep! A surprise to show our gratitude to 
our reliable vanguard! Well? Were you 
surprised!?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Even the very pinnacle of racing, giant as 
a bucket pudding, Bubble can conquer it! 
I'm rootin' for ya☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Yeah! Thanks, everyone! ...All 
right, I'm taking the top spot right now!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you sure!? Giving me such a 
fancy towel and all.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's a thank-you for always running 
alongside me. I wanted to make sure I 
expressed my gratitude while I had the 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Senior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I invite underclassmen hoping for 
some fresh energy, they usually hold back 
out of politeness~. So thank you so much, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine. I'm so happy for 
both the invite and the towel! Look 
forward to me returning the favor, okay?

"...I went to see her, wondering if she 
had calmed down by now, but apparently it 
was still too early."
choice_data_list: (She's really popular, huh...)

text_block_list.text:
Besides—I look down at the paper bag in my 
hands.
choice_data_list:
(I should have put more thought into 
preparing for this.)

text_block_list.text:
"The girls who gave her chocolates today 
all had deep feelings of their own and had 
prepared thoroughly beforehand."

To be honest, if you ask whether I had 
thought it through properly... I have to 
admit I took it with a much more 
lighthearted mindset.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should step back and regroup.)

text_block_list.text:
I'll prepare another chocolate to give 
away, and keep this one for myself... 
Deciding that, I turn on my heel and head 
toward the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was you, Trainer. It's unusual 
for you to be here at this hour.
choice_data_list: Ah, umm... No, it's just some work!

text_block_list.text:
I quickly hid the paper bag behind my back 
as I answered. ...My cheek twitched from 
the awkwardness of trying to play it off.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Work? ...Hmph, really?
choice_data_list:
M-More importantly, I saw! You were super 
popular this morning.

M-More importantly, I saw! You were super 
popular this morning.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, you saw that? Yeah, they gave me a 
whole bunch.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I should accept it with gratitude. 
I'm sure every bit of it will be full of 
flavor.
choice_data_list:
Every single one was full of heartfelt 
feelings, after all.

Every single one was full of heartfelt 
feelings, after all.

text_block_list.text:
Feelings so earnest they made me feel 
ashamed for having intended to give it so 
casually.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ? Trainer? Does that mean—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's true, I'm super happy! Chocolates 
that each person poured their feelings 
into—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Plucking up their courage to hand it over. 
It's that sincerity, you know.
choice_data_list: ...Posture?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Right, posture!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, taking that step to 'hand it 
over' is a step you can't take unless you 
truly, deeply care about me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said. Regardless of the reason 
behind it, simply 'having you give it to 
me' makes me happiest of all."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If it's between 0 and 1, I'd rather have 
1.
choice_data_list: I see... Yeah, you're right.
I see... Yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.text:
Casual though it may have been, those 
feelings for Bubblegum Fellow were 
certainly real that day.

Keep it and stay at "0", or hand it over 
and make it "1"—there's no need to even 
think about it.
choice_data_list: ...Um, Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. What is it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: This is for you!
This is for you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you prepared this for me? Thank you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's lovely wrapping. And the color is 
my favorite shade of blue.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I accept it with all my heart. Both 
your feelings, and the chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
By the way... hey! Can I open it right 
here, right now?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It feels a bit heavy for chocolate, so I'm 
really curious about what's inside!
choice_data_list:
Of course! I'm curious to see your 
reaction too.

Of course! I'm curious to see your 
reaction too.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat, this is so cuuuuute! It's a 
picture book! A picture book chocolate...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Awesome! It's even a pop-up book! 
Whoa, amazing! Soooo cool!!
choice_data_list:
You like cute things, right? I could tell 
in an instant!

You like cute things, don't you? I could 
tell in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah, totally! I love it!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I don't know what you were fretting 
over, but just by choosing this for me, 
your feelings come through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Just how seriously you've always been 
watching over me, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You really are the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose either.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.text: (*Yank!*)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It's my turn now, Trainer! âTry to 
keep up!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I was here, but 
it's so pretty~! How about you, Trainer? 
Having fun?
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. ...Wait, why an aquarium?
Y-Yeah. ...But why the aquarium?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, of course—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I wanted this Valentine's to be one that 
cuts deep into the very depths of your 
heart.
choice_data_list: !? I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Hey, come over here!

Where Bubble Gum Fellow led me was an 
underwater tunnel. And there—
choice_data_list: It's a penguin!

text_block_list.text:
Pointing toward the tank. Deep in the 
shimmering water, a flock of penguins 
could be seen. And then—
choice_data_list: Ah, jumped right in!

text_block_list.text:
One penguin took the lead and dove into 
the water. As if flying, it glided right 
overhead.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —A first penguin.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The first penguin. It's the brave penguin 
that dives into the sea first when hunting 
and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
She's so cool. Even though she's so cute, 
she's seriously cool.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A guidepost for my heart. An ideal of what 
I want to be.
choice_data_list:
...Then I guess that makes it my guiding 
light too.

...I see, so you're a guiding light for me 
as well.

text_block_list.text:
Supporting the way Bubble Gum Fellow wants 
to be. Because that is my job.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...You said it before I even got the 
chance to.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I knew it, I'm so glad I brought 
you here.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Will you accept this?

I instinctively take the bag handed to me. 
Prompted to open it, inside was...
choice_data_list: —A penguin keychain.

text_block_list.text: And this isn't just any ordinary penguin—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
This one's mine. Our names are engraved on 
the back.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer-san. No matter what sea 
it is, let's dive into it together."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Relying on this signpost, the two of us 
together!
